The Atlantic’s record‑intense hurricane is **Hurricane Wilma (2005)**, which holds the lowest central pressure ever recorded in the basin at 882 mb.  
According to its Wikipedia entry and official NOAA/US‑GSU summaries, Wilma caused **52 fatalities worldwide** – 52 people lost their lives in the Caribbean, the United States, and Mexico because of the storm.
